theme.titleEffectsOn: Visual effects: on — click for the simpler, faster look
theme.titleEffectsOff: Visual effects: off — click to bring back gradients and shadows

pairing.heading: Pair with your Hue bridge
pairing.searching: Searching for a bridge on your network…
pairing.manualHint: Needed if your bridge is on a different network segment than this computer (common for isolated IoT VLANs) — find the IP in the Hue app under Settings → My Bridge.
pairing.notFound: No bridge found automatically — enter its IP manually below.

sync.previewHint: Click a rect to blink that light. Zones update live once syncing.
sync.sourceHeldByOther: Another connected window is currently streaming — this view is a local preview only.
sync.zoneMappingHint: Which physical axis (x/y/z, from the Hue app's room layout) becomes screen-horizontal, screen-vertical, and "depth" — depth doesn't position a zone, it scales how large an area it samples. Areas disagree about axis conventions, so get this right here rather than guessing: watch the preview above while adjusting.
sync.disableEmsHint: A DTLS handshake security extension (RFC 7627) — leave unchecked. Only disable it if the handshake to your bridge fails; some older bridge firmware doesn't support it.
sync.captureScaleHint: How much of the screen's real resolution to mirror. Light sync is unaffected by this — it always works from a downscaled copy — so this only changes how sharp a recording is, and how much battery the mirror itself costs. Leave it low unless you are recording.
sync.captureWhenRunning: size shown once sync is running
sync.recordNeedsSync: Start sync first — recording mirrors the same capture.
sync.recordingHint: Records while sync runs, to Movies/HueMux. It encodes the frames sync is already capturing, so a recording is exactly as sharp as the capture resolution set above — raise that slider before recording if the video is for someone else to watch, and lower it afterwards.
sync.captureScaleLocked: Locked while recording — the video is encoded at the size it started with.
sync.debugHzHint: How often the histogram and capture readouts update. Higher is smoother but uses more network and CPU.
sync.debugPreviewHint: Sends a downscaled copy of the video grid to every connected UI. It powers the preview and histogram; it burns CPU and network, so leave it off unless you need it.
sync.audioGainHint: Boosts the captured audio before analysis. Raise it if the histogram barely moves; 2 is the default.
sync.audioFloorHint: Silences bands below this level. Use it to hide a constant hum or hiss.

lights.empty: No lights found on this bridge.

music.heading: Music reactivity
music.hint: Streams audio analysis to the engine. A preset turns that analysis into light output.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.readOnly: Settings can only be changed from the machine HueMux is running on.
settings.profileHint: Which half of the app runs. "lights" skips screen sync entirely — no DTLS stream, no capture.
settings.listenHint: When on, other devices on your local network can reach HueMux. The port can be changed if another app already uses 7654.
settings.authHint: 4 memorable words or any password. Connections from this machine are never asked for it.
settings.tlsHint: HueMux does not obtain certificates. "files" uses ones you supply — from Tailscale, or your own domain.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Collects the version, configuration, connection state and recent log into one file. Attach it to a bug report — it is the fastest way to get a problem understood. Never includes your auth token.
settings.diagnosticsShown: Shown below — select all to copy manually.
settings.diagnosticsSelectManually: Clipboard unavailable on an insecure page — the text is selected below, copy it manually.
settings.diagnosticsDownloadHint: If nothing downloaded, use View or Copy instead.
settings.languageHint: "System" follows your device. Translations other than English are machine generated — corrections are welcome on the issue tracker.
settings.directionHint: Normally follows the language — only Arabic is right to left. Forcing it is for checking that the mirrored layout is correct without having to read the language it belongs to.

auth.heading: Enter your access token
auth.errorBadToken: That token was not accepted. Check it and try again.
auth.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check that HueMux is running.
